speed_trace.description: Read game time or control pause, resume and speed. action=trace reads bounded native speed-call history without changing game state.
speed_trace.action.description: Operation: time, pause, resume, set_speed or read-only trace. Trace shows observed native calls; unattributed does not establish a human or another mod as the actor.
speed_trace.limit.description: Maximum trace records, 1..32; default 8. Without a cursor, return the latest records.
speed_trace.error.invalid_limit: Trace limit must be an integer from 1 to 32.
speed_trace.error.invalid_after_sequence: Trace afterSequence must be a nonnegative integer.
speed_trace.error.epoch_required: Trace afterSequence requires traceEpoch from a prior response.
speed_trace.error.epoch_mismatch: Trace epoch does not match this process. Read the current trace before continuing.
speed_trace.error.cursor_future: Trace cursor is newer than the recorded history.
speed_trace.error.invalid_action: Speed action must be time, pause, resume, set_speed or trace.
